title: Oracle Midday Brief
script_summary:
**ORACLE MIDDAY BRIEF**

Bitcoin holding steady at sixty-three-one-one-one, up less than a percent on the day. Volume's thin across major exchanges—typical summer doldrums territory.

Here's what matters: Fear and Greed at fourteen. That's extreme fear territory, the kind that historically precedes sharp reversals. Not saying it's guaranteed, but the sentiment floor is priced in.

On-chain signal worth watching—hashrate sitting comfortably at just over one-thousand exahashes. No miner capitulati
